biography.value: An Ancient Stone summoned is not a decision about a fight. It is a decision about a place — this ground, held against everything, for as long as necessary. Continental Tremor resets the battlefield completely on arrival. World Crush removes individuals permanently from the engagement. The Ancient Stone is old enough and intelligent enough to follow complex orders without misinterpretation, and patient enough that it does not distinguish between a fight that lasts ten minutes and one that lasts ten hours. Both are the same to it.

system.attacksNotes:
World Crush [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 20 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 20 damage (12 + 8 Str).
  • Margin 2: 20 damage, DR halved (round up); target Grappled + Restrained + Prone; takes 16 bludgeoning damage at start of each of their turns; no save; Fortitude [Hard] save each round to break free.
  • Margin 3: 20 damage, DR halved (round up) + Grappled + Restrained + Prone; target begins Engulf — driven 5 feet into the ground at start of their next turn unless they succeed on a Fortitude [Hard] save, adding Blinded and ongoing damage to 32.

Mountain Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 2 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 120/240 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 20 damage (18 + 2 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 20 damage, DR halved (round up); target knocked Prone + Stunned + all creatures within 10 feet take 8 bludgeoning damage from impact debris; no save on debris.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Immovable: Magical forced movement requires winning an opposed check against Str 8 + Might 8 [Hard]. Non-magical forced movement is impossible. Earth Bond: While standing on natural earth or stone, regains 12 HP at the start of its turn. Suppressed if it took magical damage this round. Continental Tremor (1/day) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, releases the earth's full force in an 80-foot diameter. Every non-designated creature on natural ground makes a Fortitude [Hard] save.

  • Margin 1:: 10 damage only.
  • Margin 2: 10 damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone.
  • Margin 3: 10 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Restrained for 1 hour; requires excavation to escape.

Piercing and Slashing Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 4 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical piercing and slashing damage while within 60 feet. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
system.reactionsNotes: Stone Skin [Reaction]: Once per round, reduce incoming physical damage by 14. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Ancient Stone fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.
